name: Suginami
source:
Affiliation: Informal newspaper club, Kazami affiliated junior high class 3-1

Suginami is Kiyotaka's classmate and a member of the informal newspaper club. He is cheeky, mature and intelligent.
That sparked the trouble (of various sizes), he has a nact for spotting students certain specialties.
It is said that the first day of summer, he and Morizono put cats and dogs over the newspaper and newspaper publisher.
However, at that moment, the newspaper club became overwhelmed and popular.
For some reason, he has a good relationship with Kiyotaka but constantly causes trouble, changing jobs to the informant to the newspaper club.
